resources.string: Upgrade this radio to OSHI Mesh
Free and open source. Keeps your region, channels, keys and contacts, stays on the Meshtastic network, and adds long messages, delivery receipts and messages kept for 72 h while someone is offline.
Send the flasher link to a computer
The flasher runs in Chrome or Edge on a computer, over USB. Choose “Keep my settings” to update this radio in about a minute.
